control_name: Certificates of insurance use the current ACORD 25 form
control_objective: Every certificate of liability insurance issued uses the current revision of the standard ACORD 25 form, so that certificate holders, agencies, and carriers exchange legally compliant, up-to-date certificates.
risk_addressed: Certificates issued on superseded or non-standard ACORD 25 revisions can omit required disclosures and carry stale legal language, exposing the organization to regulatory findings, certificate-holder disputes, and E&O claims.

required_data_elements.business_definition: The ACORD 25 form revision used to issue a certificate of insurance.
The current ACORD 25 revision registered in the forms library.

method.summary: Compare the ACORD 25 revision used on issued certificates against the current revision in the forms library, counting non-current issuances and computing the share of COIs using the standard ACORD 25 form.
steps: Resolve the current ACORD 25 revision from the forms library.
Pull issued certificates from policy administration over the period.
Compare each certificate's form revision against the current revision.
Count non-current form issuances and compute the percentage of COIs using ACORD 25.
method.sampling_rule: Assess all certificates issued in the assessment period.
method.fallback_logic: If the forms library or policy admin source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any certificate issued on a non-current ACORD 25 revision is a forms-governance exception.
thresholds.warning_threshold: Fewer than 100% of COIs use the standard ACORD 25 form

pass_criteria: No certificates issued on a non-current ACORD 25 revision.
All COIs use the standard ACORD 25 form.
warning_criteria: Fewer than 100% of COIs use the standard ACORD 25 form.
fail_criteria: One or more certificates issued on a non-current ACORD 25 revision.
exception_handling: Retire the superseded revision from issuance and reissue affected certificates.

assertions.description: No certificates issued on a non-current ACORD 25 revision.
All COIs use the standard ACORD 25 form.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter against the latest ACORD 25 revision.

actions_on_fail: Notify Data Architect and Forms Administrator
